mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 78 degrees. If you are looking up tonight, the International Space Station will be visible at 9:05 PM for two minutes, rising in the southwest over Mount Horeb and heading toward the east northeast over Fitchburg and Madison, reaching about halfway up the sky.

In local news, the Verona Police Department reported the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson of Madison. She was booked into the Dane County Jail on Friday for sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, with the incident dating back to the summer or fall of 2019.

Looking for things to do? We have Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, Wednesday features live music at Paddy Mac's, the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, and various trivia nights around town.
In our weekly police report, authorities arrested a former school staff member on Friday regarding an investigation into an inappropriate relationship that occurred during the summer or fall of 2019.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Georgia Peach. The store is currently open and will be serving customers until 10:00 PM tonight.
